items.source_en:
Contact: I'll make the deposit into your accounts. Your family will be taken care of for generations to come.

Ochim: And the thief?

Contact: Oh, we'll have a mountain of evidence linking them to the crime, don't you worry. Especially after you convince them they need to visit Jandar's Rest. 

It's the same as when I put the supplies on hold. You make it seem like it's THEIR idea to help the Zealots. When in reality, we're just setting them up.

Ochim: You seem pleased.

Contact: Oh, I've waited a loooong time for this one. I can't wait to see the look on his face. Or his corpse? I'm not sure.

Anyway, good job! You've served me well, but it's time we part ways. Fish and guests, as they say.

I've only got one more task for you before our business is concluded. Something to really nail down your House as the bad guy.

Ochim: And what's that?

Contact: I want Qisrani Dul'kehf dead. And I want you to convince your boss to order the hit.

Ochim: What? I do that, and I won't make it out of the city alive. It's a suicide mission.

Contact: Is there a problem? 

Ochim: Just make sure my sister is taken care of.

내가 물자 공급을 보류시켰을 때처럼, 그 도둑이 광신도들을 돕는 것같이 꾸미는 거다. 사실은 누명을 씌우는 거지만.

오킴: 그냥 제 여동생을 잘 돌봐 주십쇼.

items.source_en:
From: Azad Dubas

Hello my love. How is the work going? If I know you, the time is flying by and you've skipped at least one meal. Speaking of which, I miss your spicy stew!

Things are quiet enough here. At times, perhaps too much so. I've been keeping a close eye on the local wildlife, looking for behavioral changes following the events in Dreshdae. I can't help but wonder whether we have truly seen all of the effects from the incident.

Perhaps I'm just turning paranoid in my old age.
items.legacy_ko:
발신: 아자드 두바스

안녕, 내 사랑. 일은 잘 되고 있어? 내가 아는 자기라면 분명 시간이 정말 빨리 가고 적어도 한 끼는 걸렀을 것 같아. 그렇게 쓰고 보니, 당신의 매운 스튜가 벌써 그리워!

여기는 상당히 조용해. 가끔은 너무 조용할 정도야. 나는 드레스데에서 일어난 사건 이후 지역 야생 동물을 주의 깊게 지켜보며 행동에 변화 양상이 있는지 찾고 있어. 그 사건이 남긴 영향 중에 아직 우리가 못 본 것이 있지 않을까 궁금하거든.

아마도 내가 그냥 늙어서 편집증에 걸린 걸지도 모르지.
